entities.summary: Doneeka Danyell Lewis, née Hodges, is an American-Bulgarian professional basketball currently playing for Olympiacos in Greece. A 5–9 guard, she was drafted with the 25th overall pick in the 2004 WNBA draft for the Los Angeles Sparks, out of Louisiana State University.
